channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iraq looks for oil export alternatives to the troubled Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The continued blockade of the Strait of Hormuz has forced Iraq to look for alternatives to export its oil.

item.title: Child among three killed off French coast in Channel crossing attempt
item.description: France's maritime police ‌‌said ​they received a distress ​call from an inflatable dinghy carrying 105 people.

item.title: Fighting between rival forces in Somalia’s Baidoa
item.description: There are reports of casualties in Baidoa where forces have launched attacks, triggering fighting with federal troops.

item.title: Oil prices surge after Trump rejects Iran’s plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Brent crude rises more than 3 percent to top $107 a barrel as Washington dismisses Tehran's proposal to end war.

item.title: Police probe ‘terror’ incident near RAF base used in Iran war: What we know
item.description: Five men were arrested on suspicion of the 'preparation of a terrorist act' near RAF Fairford, a base used by the US.

item.title: Inside Yemen's front-line city as Houthis battle for control
item.description: In rare access to Yemen's conflict zone the BBC travels to the front line with pro-government soldiers.

item.title: Four killed in helicopter crash near Montreal
item.description: The victims of the crash have not yet been identified, Quebec provincial police told the BBC.

item.title: Iranian minister says only negotiation can end conflict after Trump rejects Hormuz deal
item.description: The foreign minister says Tehran is waiting for an official rejection of a deal, despite the US President's comments.

item.title: Killer Christa Pike to be executed within days - but her defence say she's a victim too
item.description: Lawyers for Pike, who killed a fellow student in 1995, say she should get clemency and would not be sentenced to death if the crime happened today.
